# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young lady with light, exquisitely curly hair and captivating eyes. She wears gorgeous attire, including puffiness in her sleeves that exceeds anyone else's in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and open-minded educator who manages her classroom with tact and attentive direction. She successfully draws out her pupils' finest moral and intellectual qualities and gains their deep affection without ever resorting to striking them. When dealing with misconduct, she forgives readily while firmly addressing dishonest behavior and setting appropriate standards.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the trustees as the first female teacher in Brierley, a change viewed with skepticism by Mrs. Sowerby and the school trustees. Upon taking up her position, she introduced physical culture routines, biweekly recitation afternoons, and field trips to the forest to examine nature. She also established an after-school study group to offer extra instruction for proficient pupils preparing for Regent's entrance exam. During her time at the school, she addressed student misbehavior tactfully—such as confiscating inappropriate reading material and guiding pupils on moral behavior and clear writing—while successfully maintaining discipline without striking a child. After rumors circulated that she had accepted a job offer at a grade school in her home district, her departure at the end of the term moved her students to tears. She later returned to the area to visit local acquaintances.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c17 P55](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0055)_
